caveats: No player ratings on the web path: best and worst are Scout's pick from shot-map numbers and goals.
Goal minutes for the first two goals differ: ESPN 25'/28', BBC text 28' and 'three minutes later'. Do not show those minutes on screen.
Shot-map sums (0.57 / 2.53) differ by rounding from the header xG; on screen use 0.56 / 2.51.
Martínez 'goals prevented' (-1.42) is computed by us from ESPN xGOT per shot and includes the penalty (0.78 xGOT); without the penalty: 3 conceded from 1.80 xGOT.
Caicedo went off at 22' after landing awkwardly (ESPN report): injury, not for banter.
No formation change in any source; tactical item is the second-half shift.
